pages.title: An Enemy Was Here
pages.text: Cause an actual random target teleport using Corrupted Pearl, Corrupted Blade or Corrupted Shield.

pages.title: An Enemy Was Here
pages.text: Use unpredictable enemy relocation as a distinct mechanic.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Pearl teleports on impact, blade teleports the struck entity and shield teleports its attacker. Protected creatures and arena restrictions cannot be bypassed.
